feed.title: IBM and CoreWeave tackle agent workload isolation
feed.summary: IBM Research is collaborating with CoreWeave to address the infrastructure challenges of agent workload isolation as AI model development evolves beyond training to include task execution and agent testing. This partnership focuses on co-designing controls, identity management, and using CoreWeave Sandboxes to provide isolated execution environments. The goal is to optimize security and performance while managing the complexities of a growing AI supply chain.

feed.title: Intel Stocks Gain 2.1% as High-NA Enters Production
feed.summary: Intel's stock gained 2.1% after its High-NA chipmaking program, in collaboration with ASML, moved beyond qualification into production for certain layers of Panther Lake processors. While this technical progress strengthens Intel's position in the foundry market, investors are awaiting evidence of competitive yields, disciplined spending, and significant customer orders to justify the current stock valuation, which is significantly above its GF Value estimate. The company still needs to demonstrate a clear business payoff from this manufacturing hurdle.

feed.title: Adobe (ADBE) Tests Its AI Story Following NHL Deal And Undervalued Narrative
feed.summary: Adobe recently announced AI and marketing partnerships with the NHL and Jet2, yet its stock price has seen significant declines over the past month and year-to-date. Despite the negative price performance, a common narrative suggests Adobe is 24.6% undervalued, with fair value estimated near $320 based on Free Cash Flow projections. feed.title: Why Caterpillar Stock Is Trading Higher During Friday's Session
feed.summary: Caterpillar Inc. (NYSE: CAT) shares are trading higher on Friday due to increased investor interest in AI infrastructure buildout and a reduced expectation for another Federal Reserve interest-rate hike. The company's Power Generation segment is experiencing rapid growth, driven by demand from data centers and major orders for natural-gas generator sets and turbines. This physical infrastructure cycle is positively impacting Caterpillar's bottom line, with a 17% year-over-year surge in Power & Energy sales in the second quarter.

feed.title: Vistra shares bounce off lows on report of $4B nuclear loan
feed.summary: Vistra Corp (NYSE:VST) shares recovered from earlier losses after a Bloomberg report indicated the Trump administration plans to offer the company a $4 billion loan package to upgrade three nuclear plants. The funding, expected to be announced by US Energy Secretary Chris Wright, would support capacity expansions at plants in Ohio and Pennsylvania. This initiative aims to quadruple US nuclear capacity by 2050 to meet rapidly growing electricity demand from data centers.

feed.title: CME Group Q3FY26 Results: Record daily volume hits 29.4 million contracts
feed.summary: CME Group reported record-breaking average daily volume (ADV) for Q3 FY26, reaching 29.4 million contracts, a 16% year-over-year increase, with September setting a new high of 31.8 million contracts. Growth was robust across various asset classes, particularly in interest rate and equity index derivatives, driven by Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures and international expansion, especially in the APAC region. The results highlight a shift towards shorter-term Treasury activity and smaller contract sizes, indicating broader market participation.

feed.title: San Diego Utility Shuts off Power to Limit Risk of Sparking Fire
feed.summary: San Diego Gas & Electric Co. has begun to shut off power to customers in an effort to prevent wildfires, driven by extreme heat and strong winds. A small number of customers in Descanso have already experienced outages, with warnings that up to 35,000 homes and businesses could be affected over the coming days. The utility is taking these measures as strong winds are expected to peak and extreme heat warnings remain in effect, elevating fire risk across the region.

feed.title: Former Tesla President Says Car Sales Are Funding the Longer Road to Robots and Cybercabs
feed.summary: Former Tesla President Jon McNeill states that Tesla's traditional car sales are crucial for funding its long-term ambitions in robotaxis and humanoid robots, which require extensive capital and development time. Despite this, he highlights that the Full Self-Driving software is a key driver of current Tesla vehicle sales, comparing its impact to the transition from flip phones to smartphones. McNeill also noted that prediction market traders were more accurate than Wall Street analysts in forecasting Tesla's recent delivery numbers.

feed.title: Here are the 76 retail stores Leslie’s will close amid bankruptcy filing
feed.summary: Leslie's Inc., a Phoenix-based company, has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in Texas and announced the closure of 76 retail stores. The company stated that it might close as many as 200 stores nationwide as part of its bankruptcy proceedings. One of the affected locations, Leslie's Pool Supplies at 44th Street and Thomas Road in Phoenix, closed on September 30.

feed.title: Sabres announce exclusive perks for KeyBank customers in 2026-27

These benefits include a free popcorn at every home game before puck drop, a special discount on a featured merchandise item at each game, and a monthly sweepstakes for unique prizes like game tickets and player meet-and-greets. Cardholders simply need to present their KeyBank debit or credit card to redeem these offers.

feed.title: KEEL Stock Drifts Lower As Traders Weigh Heavy Losses
feed.summary: Keel Infrastructure Corp. (KEEL) stock is experiencing a pullback from its late-September highs, slipping from $4.15 to about $3.59 despite securing a major government infrastructure contract. While the company boasts significant revenue and a large cash reserve, it remains deeply unprofitable with negative margins and high leverage, trading at rich multiples. Traders are observing key price levels, with potential for a break above $3.72 or below $3.37-$3.40 to dictate its next move, highlighting its speculative nature for active traders.

feed.title: Seagate Sinks 12%, Western Digital Down 10% as Toshiba Plans to Double Hard Disk Output
feed.summary: Seagate Technology (STX) and Western Digital (WDC) shares dropped significantly after Nikkei reported Toshiba's plan to double its hard disk drive production capacity for AI data centers by fiscal 2027. Toshiba, currently holding about 10% of the market, aims for 30%, posing a direct threat to Seagate and Western Digital's market dominance and pricing power, especially since their recent growth has relied on tight supply and strong pricing for high-capacity drives.

feed.title: Aevex Corp. (AVEX) Shareholders Who Lost Money Have Opportunity to Lead Securities Fraud Lawsuit
feed.summary: Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP has announced a securities fraud class action lawsuit against Aevex Corp. (AVEX), inviting shareholders who suffered losses to become lead plaintiffs. The lawsuit alleges that Aevex and certain underwriters made false statements between April 14, 2026, and June 4, 2026, by failing to disclose a pre-arranged plan to abrogate a lock-up and conduct a secondary public offering (SPO) shortly after the IPO, where all proceeds went to Madison, not Aevex. Investors have until October 20, 2026, to move to be appointed lead plaintiff.

feed.title: McDonald's 30% Slide Has Made It Cheaper, but Traffic Is Still the Problem
feed.summary: McDonald's stock has dropped over 30% from its February peak, making its valuation and dividend yield more attractive, but affordability concerns and changing consumer habits are impacting traffic. The company is facing challenges with higher costs and the potential long-term effects of GLP-1 medications on fast-food spending. McDonald's new strategy, NEXT, aims to improve restaurant economics and efficiency, with visitor traffic being the key metric to watch for a successful rebound.

feed.title: Blink cancels booth for group tied to Kroger protests
feed.summary: Blink Cincinnati abruptly canceled a booth for The Humane League, a group known for protesting Kroger's egg sourcing practices, at its "Ready. Set. Blink" kickoff event. Blink organizers stated the group's participation did not align with the event's goals, while The Humane League expressed disappointment and suggested censorship, despite Kroger being a major sponsor of Blink. The Humane League intended to educate attendees on battery cages with a family-friendly display.

feed.title: Goldgroup commits US$75mn to Mexico mine deal as shareholders back silver merger

This investment, funded by Goldgroup's cash reserves, will give them a significant stake in Luca. Concurrently, shareholders of Silver Hammer Mining and Stroud Resources approved a merger to form Silver Frontier Resources, focusing on the Santo Domingo project in Jalisco, though both transactions depend on various closing conditions.

feed.title: PNC Financial (PNC) Maintains Quarterly Dividend at $2.00 with 3
feed.summary: PNC Financial Services Group Inc. (PNC) has announced it will maintain its quarterly dividend at $2.00 per share, offering a 3.62% forward yield. feed.title: Costco faces federal lawsuit accusing retailer of selling products linked to child and forced labor
feed.summary: Costco is facing a federal class-action lawsuit in Oregon, alleging the retailer sells products sourced from child and forced labor. The lawsuit claims chocolate, cashews, and shrimp sold by Costco are linked to exploitation in West Africa, Brazil, Vietnam, Guinea-Bissau, and India. The suit seeks $200 for each eligible Oregon Costco member and an injunction to halt the company's "unlawful" business practices, highlighting Costco's marketing as an "ethically sourced" retailer.

feed.title: Fortinet (FTNT) Is Getting More Attention, What Is Behind It?

feed.title: John Deere Financial, AgVend Bring 0% & Low Rate Crop Input Financing into Retail Quote
feed.summary: John Deere Financial and AgVend have partnered to integrate 0% and low-rate crop input financing directly into retailers' AgVend platforms, making these offers visible during planning, quoting, and ordering. This initiative aims to provide growers with alternative lending options, allowing them to finance seed and crop protection purchases until November 2027, countering higher operating line interest rates. The integration also benefits retailers by taking on the financial risk and processing, functioning as an account receivable replacement tool.

feed.title: General Dynamics names Nedzbala interim IT president as Gilliland departs
feed.summary: General Dynamics has appointed Paul Nedzbala as interim president of its IT services business unit following the abrupt departure of Amy Gilliland. Gilliland had been GDIT's president since 2017, a tenure that included integrating CSRA after its 2018 acquisition and launching new technology strategies. Nedzbala, who joined GDIT via the CSRA acquisition, was previously the chief business officer.

feed.title: Hasbro Board Chair Richard Stoddart Acquires 136 Deferred Stock Units Under Compensation Plan
feed.summary: Hasbro, Inc. Board Chair Richard S. Stoddart acquired 136 deferred stock units on September 30, 2026, as part of the company's compensation plan for non-employee directors.
